$comment: eval_smoke_v2 — minimized, high-coverage subset of eval_full_v2.json for a
LOCAL SCARE smoke campaign (max 2 workers). Goal: exercise every major code
path with as few tasks as possible, NOT statistical power.
- n_seeds=1 everywhere (no distributional claims; sim has uuid4 nondet).
- Grids: LV size ladder (small/medium/large) + reconfig + all 3 CP variants.
DROPPED simbench_mvlv (778 nodes, ~7min+/task incl. oracle) — MV+LV scaling
is only partially covered; re-add for a full run.
headline + scaling + cross-sector + reconfig; scare-only elsewhere.
- Scenario kinds covered: clean, concentrated, line_stress, pv_peak,
cold_day, microgrid. Failure types: default/poisson, generator, branch,
- Ablation/sweep matrices collapsed to a smoke subset that just proves the
toggle plumbing + robustness path run (NOT per-lever attribution).
- Extensions: 2 islanding tasks + 1 temporal task (6h horizon, heaviest).
task_timeout_s=1800 covers the temporal 6h task; sim_duration 30s otherwise.
name: eval_smoke_v2
